declarations.docstring: A nonempty integer adjacency matrix satisfies the specified condition exactly when it contains a reindexed adjacency matrix of the given finite model.
A nonempty adjacency matrix satisfying the specified condition admits the required finite-model reindexing when some vertex has degree three.
In an adjacency matrix satisfying the specified condition, every vertex of degree three is adjacent to a vertex of degree one.
An adjacency matrix satisfying the specified condition has at most one vertex of degree three.
A symmetric binary adjacency matrix obtained by attaching a uniquely adjacent vertex to a relabeled path is equivalent, up to reversing the path, to the corresponding standard adjacency matrix.
